[[File:Alema_Rarheadshot.jpg|thumb|Alema Rar who used a blowgun]]
A '''blowgun''' was a weapon that was used to fire poison darts at an opponent. [[Treek/Legends|Treek]] used a blowgun to shoot [[Ewokese/Legends#F|fektur darts]] to heal others. [[Alema Rar]] used a blowgun during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] to try and kill the members of the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family]] and the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] for how they had mutilated her, however her attempts had accidentally killed the [[World Brain]] and various civilians that were present at her assassination attempts.
